16/// A DeviceN color space, written as
17/// `[/DeviceN [names] alternate tintTransform attributes?]`.
18///
19/// The alternate is DeviceCMYK, or the `cmyk_profile` ICC space with `no_device_cs`. The
20/// attributes dictionary lists each spot's Separation color space under `/Colorants`
21/// (PDF 1.3). From PDF 1.6, when spots and process colorants mix, it is an `NChannel` space
22/// whose `/Process` names the CMYK space and components; `/Subtype` and `/Process` don't
23/// exist before 1.6, and PDF/X-1a preflights reject them.
24#[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Hash, Clone)]
25pub(crate) struct DeviceNColorSpace {
26    space: DeviceNSpace,
27}
28
29impl DeviceNColorSpace {
30    pub fn new(space: DeviceNSpace) -> Self {
31        Self { space }
32    }
33}
34
35impl Cacheable for DeviceNColorSpace {
36    fn serialize(self, sc: &mut SerializeContext, chunk_container: &mut ChunkContainer, root_ref: Ref) {
37        let space = self.space;
38        let alternate_cs = RegularColor::from(cmyk::Color::default()).color_space(sc);
39        let alternate = sc.register_colorspace(chunk_container, alternate_cs.into());
40
41        for (name, cmyk) in space.spots() {
42            let colorant = SeparationColorant::Custom(name.to_owned());
43            if let Err(e) = sc.validation_store().validate_colorant(&colorant, cmyk.into()) {
44                sc.register_validation_error(e);
45            }
46        }
47
48        let tint_ref = tint_transform(&space, sc, chunk_container);
49
50        let mut separations = Vec::new();
51        for (name, cmyk) in space.spots() {
52            let separation = SeparationSpace::new(SeparationColorant::Custom(name.to_owned()), cmyk.into());
53            let cs = ColorSpace::Special(SpecialColorSpace::Separation(separation));
54            if let MaybeDeviceColorSpace::ColorSpace(cs) = sc.register_colorspace(chunk_container, cs) {
55                separations.push((name.to_owned(), cs.get_ref()));
56            }
57        }
58        let nchannel = sc.serialize_settings().pdf_version() >= PdfVersion::Pdf16 && space.has_process() && !separations.is_empty();
59
60        let chunk = &mut chunk_container.non_stream.color_spaces;
61        let mut array = chunk.indirect(root_ref).array();
62        array.item(Name(b"DeviceN"));
63        array.push().array().items(space.colorants().iter().map(|c| Name(c.name().as_bytes())));
64        write_color_space(&mut array, &alternate);
65        array.item(tint_ref);
66
67        if !separations.is_empty() {
68            let mut attrs = array.push().dict();
69            if nchannel {
70                attrs.pair(Name(b"Subtype"), Name(b"NChannel"));
71            }
72            let mut colorants = attrs.insert(Name(b"Colorants")).dict();
73            for (name, separation) in &separations {
74                colorants.pair(Name(name.as_bytes()), *separation);
75            }
76            colorants.finish();
77            if nchannel {
78                let mut process = attrs.insert(Name(b"Process")).dict();
79                match &alternate {
80                    MaybeDeviceColorSpace::ColorSpace(cs) => {
81                        process.pair(Name(b"ColorSpace"), cs.get_ref());
82                    }
83                    _ => {
84                        process.pair(Name(b"ColorSpace"), Name(DEVICE_CMYK.as_bytes()));
85                    }
86                }
87                process.insert(Name(b"Components")).array().items(PROCESS_NAMES.map(|n| Name(n.as_bytes())));
88            }
89        }
90
91        array.finish();
92    }
93}
94
95impl Resourceable for DeviceNColorSpace {
96    type Resource = resource::ColorSpace;
97}
98
99const PROCESS_NAMES: [&str; 4] = ["Cyan", "Magenta", "Yellow", "Black"];
100
101fn write_color_space(array: &mut pdf_writer::Array<'_>, cs: &MaybeDeviceColorSpace) {
102    match cs {
103        MaybeDeviceColorSpace::DeviceRgb => array.item(Name(DEVICE_RGB.as_bytes())),
104        MaybeDeviceColorSpace::DeviceGray => array.item(Name(DEVICE_GRAY.as_bytes())),
105        MaybeDeviceColorSpace::DeviceCMYK => array.item(Name(DEVICE_CMYK.as_bytes())),
106        MaybeDeviceColorSpace::ColorSpace(cs) => array.item(cs.get_ref()),
107    };
108}

110/// Write the Type 4 tint transform from the space's tints to CMYK and return its
111/// reference. It computes [`DeviceNSpace::alternate`].
112fn tint_transform(space: &DeviceNSpace, sc: &mut SerializeContext, chunk_container: &mut ChunkContainer) -> Ref {
113    use PostScriptOp::*;
114
115    sc.register_validation_error(ValidationError::ContainsPostScript(sc.location));
116
117    let n = space.colorants().len();
118    let mut code = Vec::new();
119    // The stack holds the n tints; each pass pushes one CMYK component on top.
120    for component in 0..4 {
121        let terms: Vec<(usize, f32)> =
122            space.colorants().iter().enumerate().map(|(i, c)| (i, c.alternate()[component])).filter(|(_, a)| *a > 0.0).collect();
123        // Depth of tint `i` below the top, with `extra` values pushed above the tints.
124        let depth = |i: usize, extra: usize| (n - 1 - i + extra) as i32;
125        let scale = |code: &mut Vec<PostScriptOp<'static>>, a: f32| {
126            if a < 1.0 {
127                code.extend([Real(a), Mul]);
128            }
129        };
130        match terms.as_slice() {
131            [] => code.push(Real(0.0)),
132            [(i, a)] => {
133                code.extend([Integer(depth(*i, component)), Index]);
134                scale(&mut code, *a);
135            }
136            _ => {
137                // Product of (1 - tint × alternate), then 1 minus the product.
138                code.push(Real(1.0));
139                for (i, a) in &terms {
140                    code.extend([Integer(depth(*i, component + 1)), Index]);
141                    scale(&mut code, *a);
142                    code.extend([Real(1.0), Exch, Sub, Mul]);
143                }
144                code.extend([Real(1.0), Exch, Sub]);
145            }
146        }
147    }
148    // Move the four components below the tints, then drop the tints.
149    code.extend([Integer(n as i32 + 4), Integer(4), Roll]);
150    code.extend((0..n).map(|_| Pop));
151
152    let encoded = PostScriptOp::encode(&code);
153    sc.register_limits(encoded.limits());
154    let encoded = FilterStreamBuilder::new_from_content_stream(&encoded, &sc.serialize_settings()).finish(&sc.serialize_settings());
155
156    let tint_ref = sc.new_ref();
157    let mut chunk = sc.new_chunk();
158    let mut function = chunk.post_script_function(tint_ref, encoded.encoded_data());
159    encoded.write_filters(function.deref_mut().deref_mut());
160    function.domain([0.0, 1.0].repeat(n));
161    function.range([0.0, 1.0].repeat(4));
162    function.finish();
163    chunk_container.streams.shading_functions.push(chunk);
164    tint_ref
165}
